scope: Newest-first ME5 Sinistcha and Spiritomb. Artwork and true BREAK excluded.

ruleReferences.facts: Sinistcha60HP Stage1, Hide n Sneak, MatchaSpin6+discard matching Abilities ->4counters on each opponentPokemon.
Spiritomb60HP Basic, SpiritualEnd13+discard matching Abilities ->choose2opponentPokemon, quadruple each existing counter total.

evidence.name: Matcha Spin
evidence.textEn: If you have 6 or more Pokémon that have the Hide 'n' Sneak Ability in your discard pile, place 4 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon.
evidence.textZh: 如果自己弃牌区有6张及以上拥有特性「化隐」的宝可梦的话，则在对手所有宝可梦身上各放置4个伤害指示物。

evidence.name: Spiritual End
evidence.textEn: If you have 13 or more Pokémon that have the Hide 'n' Sneak Ability in your discard pile, choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and quadruple the number of damage counters on each of them.
evidence.textZh: 如果自己弃牌区中拥有特性「化隐」的宝可梦在13张及以上的话，则选择对手的2只宝可梦，将各自身上的伤害指示物数量变为原来的4倍。
